_README: Edit this file to update player wallets WITHOUT rebuilding. Core player wallet amounts are preserved as in-game values; NPC wallets below are world/economy estimates and can be adjusted separately.

_NOTES.npc_wallet_policy: NPC wallets are not exact player inventory. They represent accessible banked funds, trade instruments, treasury access, and faction operating money.
_NOTES.big_t_note: Big T is dead, so he is not listed as an active wallet. Tea Leaf money is tracked under Chai and the Syndicate instead.
_NOTES.dead_wallet_policy: Do not list deceased people as active wallets. Use estates, receiverships, treasuries, or successor institutions instead.
_NOTES.chai_t_note: Chai T is treated as dead/inactive for wallet purposes; Tea Leaf money is tracked under the Tea Leaf Syndicate Receivership instead.
_NOTES.ruler_wallet_policy: Ruler wallets represent accessible treasury authority and diplomatic exchange instruments, not every coin in a nation.
